title: Hark: An Audiobook You Can Interrupt
excerpt: Say "wait, what did that mean?" and Hark answers from the passage you just heard, then picks up where it left off. The trick is that the question names no topic, so Hark looks up the answer by where you are in the audio, not by your words.

title: Mojo Can See, Read, and Search: An Offline Android Assistant
excerpt: Mojo runs on my Android phone, using Cactus Mirage for camera descriptions and OCR, and web search when online. Here are the routing choices, measured response times, and limits, including OCR digit errors and offline hallucinations.

title: Tiny Models, Real Games: A 21,699-Parameter Dino Policy, Perfect Tic-Tac-Toe, and Dino on an ESP32
excerpt: How a 21,699-parameter network learned to play the Chrome Dino game with no safety net, how the same recipe produced perfect tic-tac-toe, and what it looked like running on an ESP32.
